About Me

A passion for making
brides feel seen.

With 25 years of professional makeup artistry experience, I bring both depth of training and a genuine love for the craft to every client I work with. A graduate of the David Nicholas Makeup Academy and Dinair-certified in airbrush application, I've spent over two decades refining my technique — and honestly, I still get excited every single time a bride sees herself in the mirror.

My work spans an extensive range of premium brands — Bobbi Brown, Lancôme, Chanel, NARS, Dior, M.A.C, Clinique, and Estée Lauder — giving me the knowledge to find exactly what works for your skin, your features, and your vision. I stay current on every new trend and technique, because I believe you should never have to choose between timeless and fresh. You deserve both.

Having completed over 100 bridal looks throughout my career, I understand the trust a bride places in her makeup artist — and I don't take that lightly. My goal is simple: to make you feel like the most beautiful, confident version of yourself on the day that matters most.

What to Expect

When you book with Blend,
I come to you.

No need to travel or add extra stress to your wedding morning. I come directly to your home, hotel, or venue with everything needed to create a polished, prefessional makeup experience on-site. Here's what you can expect when I arrive:

✦

An Extensive Makeup Collection

A curated kit stocked with thoughtfully chosen products for a wide range of skin tones and types, so your look feels beautifully matched and wears comfortably throughout the day.

✦

Professional Brushes & Tools

Every brush, sponge, and tool needed for a polished,seamless application and a refined final result.

✦

Complexion Tailored to You

From traditional foundation to airbrush application, your complexion is chosen based on your skin type, finish preference, and how you want your makeup to wear throughout the day. The goal is a seamless, comfortable look that feels like you and photographs beautifully..

✦

An Extensive False Lash Collection

A wide selection of strip and cluster lashes, so you can choose the style that feels most natural, soft, or glam for your look.

✦

18" Professional Ring Light

Beautiful, consistent lighting helps ensure your makeup looks polished in person and photographs beautifully throughout the day.

✦

Basic Skincare Essentials

If your skin needs a little extra prep before we begin, I have the essentials on hand to help create a smooth, fresh, well-prepped canvas.

All you need to do is sit back, relax, and enjoy the moment.

Services & Pricing

Everything you need
for your perfect day.

01

Bridal Makeup

Your wedding-day makeup should feel polished, personal, and completely like you. I dedicate a full, uninterrupted hour exclusively to you—creating balanced, believable skin, seamless blending, and a look that photographs beautifully in every kind of light. I highly recommend scheduling a bridal makeup preview 4–6 weeks before the wedding. It gives us time to explore your ideas, refine the level of coverage and make any adjustments without the pressure of the wedding-day timeline.

Bride $200  ·  Bridal Preview $150

02

Bridal Party

Your bridal party, your rules. Some brides want a cohesive, coordinated look across the whole party — others want each bridesmaid to bring their own personality to the chair. Either way, I've got you covered. Every application is thoughtfully tailored to the individual while keeping the overall look of the day in harmony.

From $150 / person

03

Bridal Makeup Preview

A private, unrushed appointment of up to 90 minutes to create and refine your wedding-day makeup. Lashes are selected to complement your eye shape, comfort level, and desired finish.

This is not about locking you into a formula. It gives us time to make thoughtful adjustments until the makeup feels comfortable, photographs beautifully, and still feels completely like you.

$150 / up to 90 minutes

04

Mother of the Wedding Makeup Preview

The bride isn’t the only woman who deserves to feel certain about her makeup.

Created specifically for mothers of the bride or groom, this private preview offers time to explore coverage, color, lashes and the overall level of makeup in an unrushed setting. It is especially helpful if you rarely wear makeup, have concerns about skin texture or simply want reassurance that you will look polished without feeling overdone.

You’ve thought about everyone else. This appointment is for you.

$150 / up to 90 minutes

My Bridal Skincare Recommendations

Preparing your skin
for the wedding day.

After years of working with brides and seeing firsthand how skincare can affect the way makeup looks and wears, I’ve learned that beautiful wedding-day makeup starts long before the makeup chair.

There is no perfect 12-step routine, and I don’t believe you need a bathroom full of products to have beautiful skin on your wedding day. What matters most is finding products that work well for your skin and being consistent with them.

These are some of the products I personally use, love, or regularly recommend to clients. I’ve selected them because I think they can be genuinely useful when you’re preparing your skin for your wedding—not because they’re the latest trend or because you need to buy everything on this list.

Think of this as my curated bridal skincare shelf: a collection of products and little beauty essentials I’ve found worth recommending over the years, along with a few of my professional tips for when and how to use them.

A little planning goes a long way. Your wedding day isn’t the time to experiment with an entirely new skincare routine. Give your skin time to adjust, keep things consistent, and focus on creating a healthy, comfortable canvas for your makeup.

As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.

The products below include affiliate links. If you choose to purchase through one, I may earn a small commission at no additional cost to you — this never affects which products I recommend.

CLEANSE

COSRX Low pH Good Morning Gel Cleanser

What it does: A low-pH gel cleanser that gently removes everyday impurities without leaving the skin feeling overly stripped or tight.

Why I recommend it: A good cleanser doesn’t need to leave your skin feeling squeaky-clean to be doing its job. I like this one as a straightforward everyday option because it leaves the skin feeling clean and comfortable, which is exactly what I want before the rest of your skincare goes on. For brides, I’m a big believer in keeping the daily routine simple and consistent rather than constantly changing products in search of a quick fix.

Professional note: This is the kind of cleanser I’d consider for regular use, especially when the goal is to keep the skin comfortable and balanced while preparing for the wedding.

Shop Product → (paid link)

L’Oréal Paris Revitalift Bright Reveal Brightening Daily Scrub Cleanser

What it does: A cleansing exfoliating wash that helps remove buildup and leaves the skin feeling smoother and refreshed.

Why I recommend it: I like having a gentle exfoliating cleanser in a bridal skincare routine because keeping away that dull, buildup-heavy feeling can help the skin look smoother and more polished. The key is not to overdo it—especially as the wedding gets closer. I’d rather see a bride using a product like this consistently and comfortably than scrubbing her skin aggressively in an attempt to get that ‘perfect’ glow.

Professional note: If your skin is sensitive or you’re already using other exfoliating or retinoid products, introduce this carefully rather than automatically using it every day.

Shop Product → (paid link)

Nagracoola CLIE Facial Cleansing Brush

What it does: A silicone facial cleansing brush that helps gently work cleanser over the skin without the abrasive feel of traditional facial scrubbing brushes.

Why I recommend it: I like that this is made with silicone rather than abrasive bristles. It gives you that extra cleansing step without the harsh scrubbing that can leave the skin feeling irritated or overworked. For bridal skin, I want cleansing to feel thorough but still gentle, especially when you’re working toward smooth, comfortable skin for makeup.

Professional note: Use with a gentle cleanser and a light touch. The goal is to cleanse the skin—not scrub it.

Shop Product → (paid link)

EXFOLIATE / TONE

CA Extract & Collagen Toner Pads with Centella Asiatica

What it does: Pre-soaked toner pads designed to lightly refresh and hydrate the skin while providing a convenient skincare step with centella asiatica and collagen-focused ingredients.

Why I recommend it: I like toner pads because they make it easy to add a little extra hydration and care to the routine without making it complicated. These are especially nice when the skin is feeling a little dull or in need of a refreshing step. As with any toner pad, I’d use them gently and pay attention to how your own skin responds rather than treating them as something you need to use aggressively every day.

Professional note: If these are new to you, introduce them well before the wedding and avoid adding several new active products at the same time.

Shop Product → (paid link)

COSRX Propolis Synergy Toner

What it does: A lightweight toner that helps add hydration and leaves the skin feeling soft, comfortable, and refreshed.

Why I recommend it: This is one I like when the goal is to give the skin a little extra hydration without adding a heavy layer. It leaves the skin feeling comfortable and gives you that fresh, healthy-looking finish that I love to see when preparing skin for makeup. It’s a simple step, but those consistent hydration steps can make a big difference in how the skin looks and feels.

Professional note: Apply it consistently as part of your routine rather than trying to ‘catch up’ on hydration in the days immediately before your wedding.

Shop Product → (paid link)

TREAT

Meditherapy Retinal Skin Booster Serum

What it does: A retinal-based serum designed to support smoother-looking, more refined skin while being suitable for those who prefer a gentler approach to retinoids.

Why I recommend it: Retinoids can have a reputation for being harsh, but I like this one as a more approachable option for someone who wants the benefits of a retinoid without feeling like they are putting their skin through boot camp. I’m especially interested in products like this for brides who are preparing their skin well in advance, because I’d much rather see consistent, comfortable skincare than aggressive treatments right before the wedding.

Professional note: If you’re introducing a retinoid into your routine, give your skin plenty of time to adjust. This is not something I would recommend starting for the first time immediately before your wedding.

Shop Product → (paid link)

COSRX 6 Peptide Collagen Skin Booster

What it does: A lightweight skin booster formulated with six peptides to help support smoother-, firmer-, and more hydrated-looking skin.

Why I recommend it: I like peptide-based products as part of a bridal routine because they’re a nice way to focus on the overall condition and appearance of the skin without making the routine overly aggressive. This has a lightweight feel and is easy to layer with the rest of a skincare routine, which I think is important when we’re preparing skin for makeup. My goal is always healthy, comfortable skin that looks good on its own—not trying to force a dramatic change right before the wedding.

Professional note: This is a product to build into your routine consistently rather than something to start right before the wedding.

Shop Product → (paid link)

HYDRATE

COSRX Snail Mucin

What it does: A lightweight hydrating essence that helps leave the skin feeling moisturized, comfortable, and fresh.

Why I recommend it: I like this as a simple step for brides who want their skin to feel hydrated and look fresh without adding a heavy layer of product. Well-hydrated skin tends to give makeup a much nicer starting point, and this is an easy product to work into a routine without making things unnecessarily complicated.

Professional note: Keep your skincare consistent in the months leading up to the wedding. Your wedding morning is not the time to experiment with a completely new routine.

Shop Product → (paid link)

EYES

RoC Multi Correxion Revive + Glow Eye Balm

What it does: A lightweight eye balm designed to moisturize the delicate eye area and help it look smoother, brighter, and more refreshed.

Why I recommend it: The eye area is one of those places where hydration can make such a difference in how the skin looks, especially underneath makeup. I like using an eye product that gives the area some extra moisture without feeling heavy, helping create a smoother-looking base for concealer and makeup. When you’re preparing for your wedding, I think taking a little extra care of the eye area is worth it.

Professional note: Be gentle around the eyes and introduce any new eye product well before the wedding day so you know your skin is happy with it.

Shop Product → (paid link)

OLEHENRIKSEN Banana Bright+ Eye Crème

What it does: A moisturizing eye cream designed to brighten the look of the under-eye area and help create a smoother-looking base for makeup.

Why I recommend it: I love products that help the eye area look fresh and awake, especially when you’re preparing for bridal makeup. This gives the under-eye area a nice boost of hydration and a brighter-looking finish, which can be especially helpful when you’re going to be wearing concealer. It’s another one of those small skincare steps that can make the finished makeup look more polished.

Professional note: Introduce it well before the wedding day rather than making it a last-minute addition to your routine.

Shop Product → (paid link)

BRIDAL LIPS

LANEIGE Lip Sleeping Mask

What it does: An overnight lip mask that helps keep the lips feeling soft, smooth, and moisturized.

Why I recommend it: This is an important step in my bridal skincare routine because beautiful lip makeup starts with well-cared-for lips. I love applying this before bed so you wake up with lips that feel soft and comfortable rather than dry or flaky. It’s a simple step, but keeping your lips consistently hydrated in the weeks leading up to the wedding can make such a difference in how lipstick and lip color sit.

Bridal tip: Make this part of your nightly routine well before the wedding. Don’t wait until the night before to start taking care of your lips.

Shop Product → (paid link)

e.l.f. Glow Reviver Lip Oil Stick — Selected Bridal Shades

What it does: A hydrating, comfortable lip oil stick that gives the lips a glossy wash of color without the sticky feel of a traditional gloss.

Why I recommend it: I really like these for weddings because they feel good on the lips while still giving you that pretty, polished pop of color. They’re comfortable, hydrating, and not sticky, which is especially important on a long wedding day when you don’t want your lips feeling heavy or uncomfortable. I also love having several shades available because there are so many different bridal looks—from soft and natural to a little more rosy or romantic.

Shades

Bridal tip: Choose your shade based on your overall makeup look and natural lip color. These are also an easy option to keep with you for comfortable touch-ups throughout the day.

Shop Your Bridal Shade → (paid link)

Clicka Retractable Lip Brush

What it does: A retractable lip brush that makes it easy to apply and perfect lip color with more precision.

Why I recommend it: I love a good lip brush! There’s something about applying lip color with a brush that gives you so much more control, especially when you want a really clean, polished lip. I also love that this one is retractable, making it easy to keep clean and tucked away in your makeup bag or bridal touch-up kit.

Bridal tip: Keep one in your bridal bag for touch-ups throughout the day. A lip brush makes it easy to refresh your lip color without having to completely redo your lipstick.

Shop Product → (paid link)

WEDDING DAY ESSENTIALS

Erinde Oil Blotting Sheets

What it does: Lightweight blotting sheets that absorb excess oil and shine without adding another layer of product to the skin.

Why I recommend it: These are one of those little things I love having on hand for a wedding day. When skin starts to get a little shiny, especially through the T-zone, you don’t necessarily need more powder—you just need to take away the excess oil. I like blotting sheets because they’re quick, easy, and help freshen up the makeup while keeping the skin looking natural.

Bridal tip: Keep a few in your bridal bag for quick touch-ups throughout the day. Gently press rather than rub so you don’t disturb your makeup.

Shop Product → (paid link)

LUMIFY Redness Reliever Eye Drops

What it does: Eye drops designed to reduce the appearance of eye redness, helping eyes look brighter and more refreshed.

Why I recommend it: This is a definite must-have in my bridal kit. Redness can really show up in photographs, and I love having LUMIFY on hand to help the eyes look whiter, brighter, and more refreshed before photos. It’s such a small step, but when you’re being photographed from every angle all day, those little details can make a difference.

Professional note: If you’ve never used these before, don’t wait until the wedding morning to try them for the first time. Make sure you know how your eyes respond to them well in advance, and follow the product directions.

The Experience

What to expect
when you book with Blend.

01

Inquire

Fill out the inquiry form with your wedding date, location, and any details you have so far. Once I receive it, I'll review everything and be in touch to learn more about your wedding day and your makeup needs.

02

Connect

Once your inquiry comes through, expect a personal email from me within 48 hours. I'll be in touch to go over the details of your wedding day, your makeup vision, and any questions you may have. If you dont see a reply, be sure to check your spam folder just in case.

03

Your Preview

If you choose to book a bridal makeup preview, we’ll schedule it closer to your wedding date so we can create your look, refine the details and make any adjustments before the wedding day. Individual previews are also available for mothers of the bride or groom and other wedding-party members.

04

Wedding Day

As your wedding day approaches, I'll confirm your timeline and final details so the morning feels smooth, calm, and well organized. On the day itself, Ill arrive on-site ready to bring your vision to life.
